items.content_text: - **Kalshi partnership with Alabama-Quassarte Tribal Town draws sovereignty dispute from more than 140 tribes, Bonus.com reports** — The Alabama-Quassarte Tribal Town in Oklahoma has partnered with Kalshi to launch the PokkeTrades prediction market app, with the tribe owning the app and handling marketing while Kalshi provides the exchange infrastructure. items.title: Vanderbilt study finds Polymarket 67 percent accurate, Kalshi 78 percent and PredictIt 93 percent across 2,500 markets, BitRss reports
items.content_text: - **Vanderbilt study finds Polymarket 67 percent accurate, Kalshi 78 percent and PredictIt 93 percent across 2,500 markets, BitRss reports** — Researchers Joshua Clinton and TzuFeng Huang at Vanderbilt University examined 2,500 markets with 2.5 billion dollars in volume across Polymarket, Kalshi and PredictIt and defined accuracy by how closely odds lined up with outcomes. They found Polymarket got 67 percent of markets right, Kalshi 78 percent and PredictIt 93 percent, and noted mutually exclusive contracts occasionally moved in the same direction simultaneously. ([BitRss](https://bitrss.com/are-polymarket-and-kalshi-as-reliable-as-they-say-not-quite-study-warns-157791))

items.title: CFTC splits prediction markets from sportsbook in paired rulemaking after circuit court split, Mavengity reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC splits prediction markets from sportsbook in paired rulemaking after circuit court split, Mavengity reports** — The CFTC interim final rule follows the Third Circuit approach in KalshiEX v. Flaherty, after the Sixth Circuit in September and the Ninth Circuit in August treated sports event contracts as indistinguishable from sports wagers. The rule says sports-related event contracts on a CFTC-licensed market can fit the definition of swaps, while using agency authority to exclude far-fetched scenarios as in the 2012 rulemaking. ([Mavengity](https://mavengity.com/articles/legal/cftc-casino-gambling-exclusion-event-contracts-inclusion/))

items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket midterm election betting passes 220 million dollars, more than double the 2024 congressional cycle, Bonus.com reports** — Wagering on the 2026 midterm elections across Kalshi and Polymarket has surpassed 220 million dollars, more than double the 92 million dollars recorded in the entire 2024 congressional cycle, according to a Reuters report citing Anti-Corruption Data Collective analysis. items.content_text: - **Kalshi leads 3 million dollar prediction market lobbying push against state crackdowns, Prediction Authority reports** — Kalshi, Polymarket and the Coalition for Prediction Markets have collectively spent at least 3 million dollars on lobbying and campaign contributions at federal and state levels in 2026, according to an OpenSecrets report. items.title: Missouri hits Polymarket and Kalshi with cease-and-desist orders, Bitcoin.com News reports
items.content_text: - **Missouri hits Polymarket and Kalshi with cease-and-desist orders, Bitcoin.com News reports** — Missouri Attorney General Catherine Hanaway sent cease-and-desist letters to Polymarket, Kalshi, Crypto.com, Novig, Underdog and Robinhood, calling on them to stop offering sports event contracts to Missourians or face enforcement in 30 days.
